verdict.rationale: A native mobile app with desktop parity is a fair question for a work-management SaaS like Asana, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an Asana mobile app (iOS/Android), its features, or parity with desktop. The API, MCP server, integrations and web-UI community comments do not address mobile task management.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can manage my tasks from a full-featured native mobile app without missing desktop functionality
